article.hook: The long haul demands more than hustle. Saturn in Capricorn shows when grit turns into groundwork for what lasts decades.
article.lived: Over two and a half years, ambition sharpens into method. Contracts get rewritten, meetings stretch longer, and plans get layered with contingencies. You notice how power shifts through quiet, consistent effort - not sudden moves. Leadership no longer feels like a role to claim but a position earned through endurance and clear-eyed choices.
article.turn: The problem starts when work becomes the only measure of worth. Calendars cram with tasks that never quite finish, and the line between dedication and obsession blurs. When you judge yourself by achievement alone, you risk losing the parts of life that don’t come with a deadline or a proof point.
